title: Pure Gimmick Puppet

allow.Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force: The Rank-Up-Magic Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix searches and Puppet Parade sets: it ranks Number 40 or Number 15 up into their Number C forms.

summary: Pure Gimmick Puppet Rank 8 and Rank 9 Xyz build with Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force and generic staples. With CXyz Gimmick Puppet Fanatix Machinix and Gimmick Puppet Nightmare Forbidden in the TCG, this build uses the 2024–2025 support wave to swarm Level 8 Machines and climb into Number 15, Number C15, Number 40, and Number C40.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gimmick Puppet Rouge Doll reveals a Gimmick Puppet Xyz Monster in your Extra Deck to Special Summon both itself from the hand and a Gimmick Puppet of that Xyz Monster's Rank from your Deck (locking you to Gimmick Puppet monsters from the Extra Deck for the turn), and returns itself from the GY to the hand if sent there other than from the field.

Gimmick Puppet Little Soldiers sends a Gimmick Puppet of a different Level (such as Level 8 Dreary Doll or Rouge Doll) from the Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon to copy its Level, and banishes itself from the GY to raise up to 2 Gimmick Puppets' Levels by 4.
Condolence Puppet sends Gimmick Puppet monsters with different names from your Deck to the GY up to the number of Extra Deck monsters the opponent controls + 1.

Gimmick Puppet Terror Baby revives a Gimmick Puppet in Defense Position on Normal Summon and banishes itself from the GY so the opponent cannot respond to your Gimmick Puppet monster effects that turn.

summary.title: Opening: Rouge Doll or Little Soldiers into Fantasix Machinix
steps: Reveal Rank 8 Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix in your Extra Deck with Gimmick Puppet Rouge Doll to Special Summon Rouge Doll from the hand and a second Level 8 Gimmick Puppet from the Deck (or Normal Summon Little Soldiers to dump Dreary Doll and become Level 8).
Overlay two Level 8 Gimmick Puppets into Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix, and detach 1 material to search Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force and gain an additional Machine Normal Summon.

Extend with Gimmick Puppet Fiendish Knight, Dreary Doll (banishing a Gimmick Puppet from the GY to revive itself), or Cattle Scream to assemble a second Rank 8 Xyz such as Number 40: Gimmick Puppet of Strings or Number 15: Gimmick Puppet Giant Grinder.

Activate Rank-Up-Magic Argent Chaos Force to rank up into Number C40: Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings or Number C15: Gimmick Puppet Giant Hunter, triggering Fantasix Machinix to revive itself and recycle Argent Chaos Force from the GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Burn Payoff
points: Gimmick Puppet Fantasix Machinix searches any Rank-Up-Magic Spell and grants an extra Machine Normal Summon, then revives itself from the GY whenever you Special Summon another Gimmick Puppet Xyz Monster and adds a Rank-Up-Magic from your GY to your hand.

Number 40: Gimmick Puppet of Strings (Limited) places String Counters on all other face-up monsters, and Number C40: Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings (Limited) destroys all monsters with String Counters on summon, draws 1 card, and burns for the highest original ATK among them.

Number 15: Gimmick Puppet Giant Grinder detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to destroy an opponent's Special Summoned monster (burning for its original ATK if it was an Xyz Monster), and Number C15: Gimmick Puppet Giant Hunter destroys any card the opponent controls and burns if it was a monster.
Service Puppet Play steals opponent monsters up to the number of Gimmick Puppet Xyz Monsters you control, while Number 88: Gimmick Puppet of Leo threatens an alternate win condition.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: CXyz Gimmick Puppet Fanatix Machinix and Gimmick Puppet Nightmare are both Forbidden in the TCG, removing the turn-1 FTK and Puppet-lock lines featured on the page.
